# Advior Automation

> Advior Automation builds custom AI agents, LLM integrations, and workflow automations for growing companies. Work runs inside the tools a team already uses (n8n, Make, Zapier, Slack, WhatsApp, CRMs, inboxes, spreadsheets). Fixed scope from $1,500, live in about 2 working weeks. A small team in Nairobi, Kenya, working worldwide.

Key facts:

- Fixed scope pricing: Automation Sprint from $1,500 (one workflow, up to 3 tool integrations, one AI step, written runbook, 30 days of fixes) or System from $4,500 (up to 5 connected workflows, a custom AI agent, error handling, 90 days of support).
- Human approval checks stay in the loop before anything irreversible happens.
- Sprint includes a process audit first; the automation is built on the client's real data and tested before go-live.
